variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Dispatch and arrival are different events, and this report establishes only the former. Readers considering {target} should not be asked to accept an invented landing, confrontation or account of force as part of the news of its departure.

The gazette records the dispatch without anticipating subsequent events. A precise account should not describe the expedition as present in the colony or attribute an encounter to it. The punitive purpose is established, while composition, timing and any eventual action remain outside the particulars supplied to this notice.

The conduct of {target} warrants scrutiny in relation to the dispatch. This newspaper does not treat the expedition's purpose as evidence of an unreported encounter or an established outcome in the colony. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.
